_what: Q86 inc.15 — rulings on `Notes by Gemini` docs someone OPENED. Same contract as notion-read-confirmations.json: a ruling is recorded, never inferred from size or shape.

confirmations.note: Read 2026-08-07 end to end via the Drive MCP — Q86 inc.18, the largest of the three remaining measured-unread docs (14,199 bytes). THERE IS NO TRANSCRIPT HALF. The export is a '# Notes' document only — Summary / Decisions (Needs Further Discussion + Aligned) / Next steps / Details — and it terminates in Gemini's own footer ('You should review Gemini's notes to make sure they're accurate'). ZERO timestamp headings, ZERO speaker-turn markers, ZERO disfluencies: every sentence is Gemini's third-person prose about the call ('Dix thedev08 provided a live demo of a skin lesion triage model'), never a word anybody said. Contrast the two docs ruled before it, which each carried a literal '# Transcript' half under 55 and 101 '### HH:MM:SS' headings. THIS IS THE FIRST SUBSTANTIAL DOC TO COME BACK summary-only, AND IT IS THE POINT: 14,199 bytes of genuinely rich content — 10 Aligned decisions, 20 next steps, 40 Details bullets — and not one of them is coverage. The two prior rulings both found transcripts in big docs (41,827 and 67,517 bytes) and the only summary-shaped ruling so far was the 3,186-byte apology, which together read like 'big means transcript'. This doc breaks that in the direction that costs coverage rather than the direction that flatters it, and it is the third consecutive proof that ruling by size is forbidden — here it would have wrongly ADDED a transcript to the board. NOT COVERAGE: the 2026-07-29 row keeps whatever transcript its Fireflies records hold, and gains nothing from this file. COUNT CORRECTED ON RE-READ: the doc was re-opened end to end before this was committed and the Details bullets number 40, not the 38 first written down — 10 Aligned and 20 next steps both hold. The miscount changes no verdict, and it is written here rather than silently overwritten because a committed count is evidence and evidence gets corrected in the open.
